questions.prompt: What is unsafe about annotating mutable Cart as Stable?
questions.explanation: A false stability promise can let the runtime skip UI that needed an update.
options: It stores too much saved state

questions.prompt: Recomposition count by itself proves a user-visible performance problem.
questions.explanation: Cost, phase, frequency, build, and observed user impact must be measured together.

questions.prompt: Which placement API normally respects layout direction?
questions.explanation: It interprets horizontal position relative to the current layout direction.

questions.prompt: A custom layout can freely measure each child several times.
questions.explanation: Compose custom layout measurement permits each child once per pass.

questions.prompt: Which modifier prepares reusable drawing objects?
questions.explanation: It rebuilds cached drawing data when relevant inputs or size change.

questions.prompt: Canvas paths automatically expose chart values to accessibility services.
questions.explanation: Drawn pixels need explicit semantics and equivalent content.

questions.prompt: What should implement an ordinary icon-only Save action?
questions.explanation: It supplies expected semantics, focus, feedback, and interaction behaviour.

questions.prompt: Independent blocking gesture detectors can simply run one after another in one pointerInput block.
questions.explanation: Detector loops block; independent detectors need composition or separate modifier nodes.
